```python
# filename: seahorse_clean.py
import pandas as pd
import tabula

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/67e8878b-5cef-4375-804e-e6291fdbe78a.pdf"

# Extract all tables
tables = tabula.read_pdf(pdf_path, pages='all', multiple_tables=True)
df = pd.concat(tables, ignore_index=True)

# Identify section headers
headers = {"Hotels", "Motels", "Villas", "Guesthouses", "Inns", "Resorts", "Cottages", "B&Bs"}
current_type = None
types = []
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    name = str(row.get('Name', '')).strip()
    if name in headers:
        current_type = name
        types.append(None)  # header row
    else:
        types.append(current_type)

df['Type'] = types

# Filter out header rows and keep only rows with numeric ratings
clean_df = df[(df['Type'].notnull()) & (df['Rating (out of 5)'].notnull())]
final_df = clean_df[['Name', 'Type', 'Rating (out of 5)']].copy()

print(final_df.head(12))
print("Counts per Type:\n", final_df['Type'].value_counts())
```
